summary.intent: Monitor PR #349 for new automated reviews from CodeRabbit and Copilot, and automatically resolve them as they arrive.
summary.outcome: Successfully resolved 11 review comments across two rounds: 4 Copilot threads (docs + a real recovery.html IPNS bug), 2 CodeRabbit outside-diff comments (including a useAuth.ts catch scope bug), and 7 more Copilot threads (docs/label fixes + dismissals). Monitoring loop runs every 5 minutes via cron job cadb6bcb.

repo: VaultBlobV2 type was removed — functions that previously returned it now return Uint8Array directly.
The v2 vault blob is key-only (ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey), not key+metadata as older docs stated.
IPNS names must be derived separately: vault key IPNS (deriveVaultKeyIpnsName) vs root folder IPNS (deriveVaultIpnsName) — conflating them is a silent bug that breaks folder traversal in recovery.
fetchFromIpfs uses Axios and throws on 404 for missing CIDs, so a broad catch around vault load + IPFS calls will misclassify an IPFS 404 as a new-user condition.
GitHub GraphQL reviewThreads query only surfaces inline threads; outside-diff review comments appear in the review body and are not returned as unresolved threads — the polling query missed them.
Copilot reviews can arrive without creating new unresolved threads if their comments fall outside the diff range.

code.finding: Broad try/catch around getVault() + subsequent IPFS calls meant any IPFS 404 (e.g. missing CID for existing user) would incorrectly trigger vault initialization. Fixed by giving getVault() its own isolated try/catch.

directRootIpnsName was derived using the vault key IPNS derivation path but then used for root folder traversal — should use a separate VAULT_ROOT_FOLDER_HKDF_INFO constant and deriveVaultIpnsName function.
Encryption table described v2 blob as 'ECIES (key) + AES-256-GCM (metadata)' but v2 is key-only: 'ECIES (wrapped rootFolderKey only)'.
Source files section referenced VaultBlobV2 type which no longer exists — should reference Uint8Array return type.
IPNS table described v2 as 'v2 blob (ECIES key + metadata)' — corrected to 'v2 key blob (ECIES-wrapped rootFolderKey)'.

workflow: The /loop skill parses an interval + prompt and creates a CronCreate job, then immediately executes the prompt once before the first scheduled tick.
GraphQL reviewThreads(first:50) only returns inline threads — outside-diff review comments require fetching the review object directly (e.g. gh api repos/.../reviews/ID/comments).
When Copilot posts outside-diff comments the polling loop reports 0 unresolved threads, causing silent misses; manual intervention was needed.
Replying to outside-diff comments requires posting a PR-level comment rather than a thread reply, since there is no thread ID to target.
Running pnpm typecheck is sufficient to validate recovery.html JS changes via the monorepo tsconfig; no separate build step needed for the HTML file.

friction: GitHub API timed out on one polling tick, causing a false 'no new reviews' report.
The GraphQL reviewThreads polling query does not surface outside-diff comments, so 2 CodeRabbit and 7 Copilot comments were invisible to the monitor until the user manually flagged them.
Multiple Read tool calls on the same file sections were needed to navigate recovery.html due to its size, slowing triage.
Indentation inconsistency was introduced during the useAuth.ts edit and required a follow-up fix pass.
open_items: Cron job cadb6bcb (every 5 min, auto-expires 7 days from creation) still running — does not catch outside-diff comments; consider supplementing with a review-body fetch.
The 7 Copilot comments about sequence=0 on initial IPNS publishes were dismissed rather than fixed — worth revisiting whether sequence should be explicitly set on first publish.
useAuth.ts fix was not covered by a unit test — the misclassification bug could regress silently.
